The '''Sermerian Bio-League''' was an organization in existence on the planet [[Sermeria]] around the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Bio-League assisted a bomb squad in containing the threat of a suspicious package that arrived at the government building in [[Addolis]], the planet's capital. [[Sermerian First House|The government]] was forced to shut down while the bomb squad and the Bio-League neutralized the threat.
